We will deliver State Life’s modern corporate website and integrated customer self-service portal using a controlled, security-first lifecycle aligned to our ISO 9001 quality management and ISO 27001 information security practices [CO-PROFILE]. Our approach is informed by delivering citizen-/customer-facing digital platforms (e.g., LMS development) [CAP-010][CAP-046] and transaction-heavy financial solutions (mobile banking) [CAP-035][CAP-011], alongside secure enterprise integrations (ERP) [CAP-026][CAP-050] and cloud implementations for government clients [CAP-012][CAP-048].

Methodology (phased, with sign-offs): (1) Discovery & requirements elaboration; (2) UX/UI and information architecture; (3) Build (CMS-backed corporate website + portal); (4) Integrations (core policy system via REST APIs + payment gateway); (5) Security hardening & testing; (6) Cloud deployment; (7) Training, documentation, and handover; (8) One-year warranty support.

For the portal, we will implement secure authentication, role-based access control, and audit-ready logging consistent with an ISO 27001-aligned delivery model [CO-PROFILE]. We will design responsive user journeys for “view policies, download documents, raise service requests, and online premium payments,” using iterative prototypes and usability feedback before full build-out.

For integrations, we will define API contracts, implement resilient REST consumption patterns, and execute end-to-end test cycles that validate policy data retrieval and transaction reconciliation. Our experience delivering mobile banking solutions supports a disciplined approach to payment workflows, error handling, and secure transaction processing [CAP-035][CAP-011].

Deployment will target State Life’s cloud environment, leveraging our government cloud delivery experience [CAP-012][CAP-048]. During the one-year support period, we will operate an in-country support desk with 24–48 hour response SLAs and planned preventive maintenance [CO-PROFILE].

Our library does not yet evidence a prior “corporate website + insurance self-service portal” as a single named reference; we will de-risk this by reusing proven patterns from our LMS and mobile banking deliveries and assigning PMP-certified project management throughout execution [CO-PROFILE][CAP-010][CAP-035].
